# subconverter-ts

> TypeScript rewrite of tindy2013/subconverter: an isomorphic subscription converter. It parses
> proxy share links and client configs (Clash, Surge, Quantumult X, Loon, sing-box, ss/ssr/vmess/
> vless/trojan/hysteria2/tuic/anytls/ssd/base64 lists) into one proxy model and re-emits them in
> the target format. Runs on Node.js, in the browser, and as a CLI.

## Key facts

- Repository: https://github.com/jinganix/subconverter (GPL-3.0)
- npm packages: `@subconverter/core`, `@subconverter/node`, `@subconverter/browser`,
  `@subconverter/cli` (all versioned in lockstep)
- Runtime: Node.js >= 22; browser build ships ESM plus the IIFE global `SubConverter`
- Layout: npm workspaces monorepo with a one-way dependency graph `core` ← `node`/`browser` ← `cli`
- `packages/core` is platform-free: no `node:*` imports and no DOM globals
- Default behavior: rules are ON. `generate()` with no rulesets falls back to bundled
  upstream-like defaults; pass `includeRules: false` (`no_rules` / `--no-rules`) to strip them
- Surge target defaults to version 5 (`surgeVersion`)
- Entry points: `parseSubscription()` → `Proxy[]`, `generate(nodes, { target })` → `string`,
  `TargetFormat` enum for the output target
- Targets: `clash`, `clashr`, `surge`, `surfboard`, `quanx`, `quan`, `loon`, `mellow`,
  `singbox`, `v2ray`, `trojan`, `ss`, `ssr`, `sssub`, `ssd`, `mixed`, `nodelist`, `auto`
  (parsing only). Each target drops unsupported node types silently
- Protocols: `ss`, `ssr`, `vmess`, `vless`, `trojan`, `socks5`, `http`/`https`, `hysteria`,
  `hysteria2`, `tuic`, `anytls`, `wireguard`, `snell`
- HTTP server: `startServer()` in `@subconverter/node`, plus the `subconverter serve` CLI command
- Faithful port: when changing parser/generator behavior, mirror upstream
  tindy2013/subconverter semantics exactly, including quirks

## Source map

- `packages/core/src/index.ts`: public API barrel (single source of truth; `docs/API.md` and
  `llms.txt` describe only what it exports)
- `packages/core/src/parser/`: link and config parsers (`subscription.ts` auto-detects input)
- `packages/core/src/generator/`: one module per output target (`clash.ts`, `surge.ts`,
  `singbox.ts`, `loon.ts`, `quanx.ts`, ...), plus `nodes.ts` for rename/emoji/country handling
- `packages/core/src/engine.ts`: `generate()`, the isomorphic generation entry point
- `packages/core/src/types/`: `Proxy`, `TargetFormat`, `ExtraSettings`, proxy groups, rulesets
- `packages/core/src/settings/`: external INI parsing and `/sub` query-string parsing
- `packages/node/src/index.ts`: fetch/fs loading, conversion pipeline, GeoIP resolver
- `packages/node/src/server.ts`: `/sub`, `/version`, and usage routes
- `packages/browser/src/index.ts`: browser loading plus core re-exports
- `packages/cli/src/cli.ts`: argument parsing and the `convert` / `serve` / `parse` / `formats`
  commands

## Commands

```bash
npm install
npm run build          # tsup bundles for every package
npm run typecheck      # tsc per package
npm run lint           # eslint, zero warnings
npm test               # vitest
npm run check          # typecheck + lint + test + docs freshness
npm run docs:api       # regenerate docs/API.md from the barrels
npm run docs:check     # docs/API.md + README enum coverage drift guard
```

## Usage

```ts
import { generate, parseSubscription, TargetFormat } from "@subconverter/core";

const nodes = parseSubscription(await response.text());
const clash = generate(nodes, { target: TargetFormat.Clash });
```

```bash
subconverter convert --url https://example.com/sub --target clash --out clash.yaml
subconverter serve --port 25500 --host 0.0.0.0
```

## Optional

- [Upstream project](https://github.com/tindy2013/subconverter): the C++ implementation this port
  follows for parser and generator semantics
